name: NeuroScan Brain-MRI Tumor Classifier
task: 4-class brain MRI tumor classification (Glioma, Meningioma, Notumor, Pituitary)

architecture.head: GlobalAveragePooling -> Dropout(0.3) -> Dense(256, ReLU) -> Dropout(0.4) -> Dense(4, logits)

training.phase_1: Backbone frozen, train head — Adam (lr 1e-3), 4 epochs
training.phase_2: Unfreeze top ~1/3 of backbone (BatchNorm frozen) — Adam (lr 1e-4), up to 16 epochs
training.augmentation: Random horizontal flip, rotation (±0.08), zoom (0.1), contrast (0.1)
training.calibration: Post-hoc temperature scaling fit on the validation set

data.preprocessing: Resize to 224x224, RGB; EfficientNet handles normalization internally

intended_use.primary: Research and educational decision support for brain MRI interpretation; PhD study artifact.
intended_use.users: Researchers, radiology trainees, and demonstration audiences.
intended_use.out_of_scope: Not a certified diagnostic device. Must not be used for autonomous clinical diagnosis.

ethical_considerations: Predictions are probabilistic and can be wrong; confidence is calibrated but not a guarantee.
Trained on a limited public dataset that may not represent all scanners, populations, or pathologies.
Should always be combined with expert radiological assessment and clinical correlation.
caveats: Performance is reported on a held-out test set from the same data distribution.
DICOM ingestion converts to a single normalized 2D slice; volumetric context is not modeled.
Most residual errors occur between Meningioma and Pituitary classes.
